module: I1 - Dwellers of the Forbidden City [PRC8-CEP2]

items.Name: Ancient Blade of Quickness
items.Description: Cast from bronze, but enchanted by magic, this ancient blade is a dangerous weapon.

items.Name: Potion of Animal Control
PropertiesDecoded: Hold Animal (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Black Brotherhood Key
items.Description: This crystal key opens a door in the lair of the Black Brotherhood.

items.Name: Black Moran's Waraxe
items.Description: Black Moran's Black Moran's Axe was made by the best Duergar smiths.

items.Name: Bullywug "God" Egg
items.Description: This is a 'god-egg' of the bullywugs. The Master has agreed to guard and incubate the egg. Through this he hopes to gain the trust of the bullywugs. The 'god-egg' is actually a dragon egg. To see that the egg was protected, The Master had summoned the invisible stalker.

items.Name: Mongrelmen Chief's Spear
items.Description:
This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

Showing this mongrelmen chief's spear to Gianner will show that you have defeated their faction in the Forbidden City.

items.Name: Crossbow of Accuracy
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Crown of Delgoss
items.Description: This ancient golden crown is actually made for monarchs that need to be more impressive at specific times.
PropertiesDecoded: Eagle's Splendor (10) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Crystal Key
items.Description: This crystal key opens a door and it seems to be very valuable.

items.Name: Elven Amulet +1
items.Description: When old age forced his retirement from combat, the warrior Telenn became a tutor instead, instructing local youths in the fighting arts. His longtime interest in magic was rekindled and, as his skills improved, he began creating these amulets to prevent his students from injuri…

items.Name: Elven Blade +1
items.Description: This weapon bears the mark of the dwarf Marrok, Master Blacksmith of Neverwinter's Shining Knight Arms and Armor. He forged it early in 1373 DR, to aid the heroes who sought to free his quarantined city from the virulent grasp of the so-called Wailing Death.

items.Name: Elven Chain
items.Description: These mithral chainmail suits are sought after by many, but rarely found outside of elven hands. Exquisite craftsmanship is a hallmark of the Fair Folk, and these suits are no exception.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: Elven Lord's Ring
items.Description: Once the family heirloom of an elven paladin lord, this unassuming protective ring was lost with the fall of its owner in combat.

items.Name: Elven Shield +1
items.Description: This magic shield grants additional protection to its wearer, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Emerald of Recall
items.Description: This stone was given to you by the merchant healer, Gianner. It will take you to his tent when you use it.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Faction Map
items.Description: As you encounter and remove more factions, you will be able to traverse their locations faster due to this map that Gianner gave you.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Fairburne's Greatsword +1
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Fauchard Fork
items.Description: Often identified with the small tip, it seems to have had a totally different origin and to be an offspring of the axe, not the billhook, and may be identified with the crescent shaped double-socketed axe.

items.Name: Hepmonaland Outfit
items.Description: An exotic costume from an equally exotic land.

items.Name: Gavin's Wakizashi
items.Description: Some master swordsmen are said to be able to wield two wakizashi at the same time, creating a whirlwind of steel and death.

items.Name: Goblin Note
items.Description:
This short rotting piece of paper has what seems to be the same message, written in common, goblin, Orc, and Gnoll.

"Do not let anyone enter here! We need time to assemble our army! 
We are almost ready to enslave this entire region! 

Remember, forgetful fools, the password is…

items.Name: Archer's  Belt
items.Description: Having felt the sting of Sundabar's archers in too many raids, the orcs from the spine of the world were thrilled when King Obould Many-Arrows suggested that his shamans should create a belt to protect the most worthy and cunning warriors of the tribe. The contests to decide who…

items.Name: Golden Daikyu
items.Description: The daikyu is a longbow. The grip on this bow is actually placed 2/3 of the way down the shaft, making them useable from horseback or on the ground with ease in spite of their length. This one has been enchanted.

items.Name: Golden Idol
items.Description:
This idol is used by Horan’s agents to
show the Main Entrance guards that they are on Horan’s business and guaranteed safe passage.

items.Name: Jade Key
items.Description: This jade key opens a door on the far side of the room, and it worth some serious gold!

items.Name: Gromunuk's Greatsword
items.Description:
Gromunuk's Greatsword is enchanted by that selfsame Ogre Mage to be a formidible weapon.

Showing this Item to Gianner would show him that you have defeated one of the factions of the Forbidden City.

items.Name: Guggpor's Whip
items.Description: Guggpor was a strong Ogre who held sway over much of the Forbidden City's Hidden Army. Over land and later sea, he fought over and obtained strong magical items, like this whip.

items.Name: Helmet of Mystic X
PropertiesDecoded: Lawful Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Helm of Clarity
items.Description: This helm appears ordinary until its true nature is perceived. Made of brilliant silver and polished steel, the Helm of Brilliance is set with diamonds, rubies, fire opals, and opals, each of large size and enchanted.  When struck by bright light, the helm scintillates and sends…

items.Name: Horan's Spellbook
items.Description:
First level: affect normal fires, charm person, comprehend languages, erase, magic missile, protection from evil, push, unseen servant, ventriloqulsm.

Second level: detect invisibility, ESP, forget, invisibility, Leomund’s trap, locate object, magic mouth, ray of enfeeblement, …

items.Name: Journal of Horan
items.Description:
Horan has settled in the city and is responsible for the increased raiding by the yuan ti. 

He is attempting to unite the disorganized bands of the city. He plans, once he has succeeded, to expand his control into the lands around to create a new empire. 

He leads the yuan ti …

items.Name: Mage Chest Key
items.Description: This key opens a many magical chests.

items.Name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
items.Description: Used as often in the peasant's home as the dungeon's dark, these simple concoctions are common throughout the Flanaess.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Light Wounds (2) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Cure Serious Wounds
items.Description: With the power to staunch the flow of blood or knit a broken bone, these potions are in common use among the dangerous professions.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Serious Wounds (10) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Cure Critical Wounds
items.Description: With the power to return people from the very brink of death, these potions do not come cheaply.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Critical Wounds (12) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Philter of Persuasiveness
items.Description: This milky red potion seems to open the drinker's perception of his environment, making him at once more observant and more resistant to effects that target the mind.
PropertiesDecoded: Hold Monster (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.Description: These curative potions are too expensive for most civilians, and are used almost exclusively by soldiers and adventurers.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Moderate Wounds (6) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Mechants' Goods
items.Description: In this crate are the accumulated items that the merchants lost from various Yuan-ti and Black Brotherhood raids in the region.  You should bring it back to Gianner.

items.Name: Jadeclaw's Dragon Blood
items.Description: This is the blood of the dragon Jadeclaw. Bringing it to Gianner will show that you have dealt with the Yuan-ti faction.

items.Name: Javelin
items.Description: A javelin is a light spear designed primarily for casting as a ranged weapon. The javelin is almost always thrown by hand, unlike the arrow and slingshot, which are projectiles shot from a mechanism. However, hurling devices do exist to assist the javelin thrower in achieving gr…
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 80% of Weight

items.Name: Jeweled Headband
items.Description: This bugbear's jeweled headband is actually a human’s belt.

items.Name: Longsword +1, +3 vs. Regenerating Creatures
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.
PropertiesDecoded: Giant Enhancement Bonus vs. Racial Group +3

items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Magic Leather Armor +1
items.Description: This magic armor grants additional protection to its wearer, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Magic Harp
items.Description: This magic harp seems to deny all forms of identification.

items.Name: Marcella's Cleaver
items.Description: One of the first types of sword to come into existence, the short sword is a double-edged weapon about two feet long. It is an economical weapon, and a favorite of archers and rogues. Made for the kitchen, this blade can do horrendous damage in skilled hands.

items.Name: Marcella's Shortbow
items.Description: A shortbow has a stave portion of about five feet in length. The shortbow was the first of such launchers to be developed, and it remains an effective weapon. This bow makes a good defensive weapon, as well as offensive.

items.Name: Marcella's Longsword
items.Description: The longsword is the weapon most commonly associated with knights and their ilk. There are many variations in the blade, but all are approximately 35 to 47 inches in length. This fencing sword seems to be made for parrying and stopping attacks.

items.Name: Master Key
items.Description: This key opens a door of someone called the "Master".

items.Name: Mechants' Goods
items.Description: In this huge crate are the remainder of the accumulated items that the merchants lost from various Yuan-ti and Black Brotherhood raids in the region. You should bring it back to Gianner.

items.Name: Miniature Carved Chest
items.Description: This is a miniature elaborately carved chest. It needs someting else to open it.

items.Name: Black Moran's Banded Mail
items.Description: Black Moran's Banded Mail was made by the best Duergar smiths.

items.Name: Olaf's Gauche
items.Description: The gauche is a light, flexible blade used in the off-hand when wielding a rapier.

items.Name: Berserker Elite Greataxe
items.Description: Berserker Elite Greataxes are rust colored and razor sharp; often doing critical damage with the simplest strike.

items.Name: Orrem's Hammer +2
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Pan Lung's Heart
items.Description: This Pan Lung's Heart should be taken to Gianner, to show have destroyed the bullywug faction.

items.Name: Potion of Clairaudience
items.Description: With the power to return people from the very brink of death, these potions do not come cheaply.

items.Name: Potion of Healing
items.Description: Used as often in the peasant's home as the dungeon's dark, these simple concoctions are common throughout Oerth.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Light Wounds (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Extra Healing
items.Description: With the power to return people from the very brink of death, these potions do not come cheaply.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Critical Wounds (15) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Freedom
items.Description: With their ability to smooth the complexion, gloss the hair, and brighten the eyes, these potions find regular use among the nobility. But it shall make anyone more comely.
PropertiesDecoded: Freedom of Movement (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Quarterstaff of X
items.Description: X's Magic staff seems tailor made for him.
PropertiesDecoded: Lawful Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Ranet Temple Key
items.Description: This strange key has the words "Glory to Ranet" engraved into it.

items.Name: Ring of Spell Storing
items.Description: As a child, Lady Aribeth de Tylmarande helped to save her home of Thundertree from the spells of a power-hungry Luskan wizard, doing so with the aid of this ring. Crafted by the elves of the Neverwinter Wood and given to her by the ranger Ansal Bloodshoulder, it was once a dear …
PropertiesDecoded: Bard Bonus Spell Slot of Level Level 1
Sorcerer Bonus Spell Slot of Level Level 1
Wizard Bonus Spell Slot of Level Level 1

items.Name: Ritual Dagger
items.Description: Showing this tasloi ritual dagger to Gianner will show that you have defeated their faction in the Forbidden City.

items.Name: Robe of Cold Resistance
items.Description: Protective garments such as this one are usually made by a wizard to protect a clumsy assistant.

items.Name: Rod of Absobtion
items.Description: These devices are pleasant enough to look at, crafted of solid oak and highlighted with a modest gem or two. More importantly, the rods are potent magic items, capable of calming even the angriest of souls. In the hands of one with a quick tongue, the rods are more than worth th…

items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Rope
items.Description: This rope could be useful at some point.

items.Name: Rope of Climbing
items.Description: This rope of climbing could be useful at some point. Made of enchanted silks, it weighs much less than it should.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: Scimitar +3, Frost Brand
items.Description: This magic weapon has an enhancement bonus to attack and damage, but it doesn't bear the hallmarks of any specific maker.

items.Name: Spy Network
items.Description:
There is a small diary written at the back of this ancient, unreadable tome.

In order to learn the movements of caravans through the jungle, the inhabitants of the city have established a spy network in the area. The raids continued so long as the spies existed, but destroying …

items.Name: Strategy Map
items.Description: This map seems to have key supply lines, fortifications, and patrol movements of local governments' armed forces. Someone could use this to inflict great damage on the region.

items.Name: Studded Leather
items.Description: Made of soft leather with steel rivets embedded in the surface, this armor offers more protection than a leather breastplate, but far more mobility than heavier armors. Armor of this type is popular amongst archers, rangers, and others who value mobility as much as protection.

items.Name: Tasloi Club
items.Description: Taken from a decaying body, this bloody leg bone works well as an improvised club.

items.Name: Tasloi Dart of Stunning
items.Description: Darts of this type can stun their targets, though potency and duration are determined by the power of the dart's creator.

items.Name: Temple of Ranet
items.Description:
Under the forbidden city stretches the ancient primitive sewer system. 

In it now live monsters and creatures of all sorts. But, most common are the jungle - ghouls and the last human descendants of the yuan-ti ancestors. 

The ghouls and humans wage a constant war of attacks, …

items.Name: Valuable Vase
items.Description: Perhaps Gianner will trade you a lot of gold for this valuable vase.

items.Name: Wand of Ice
items.Description: Wands of Fire draw upon a discipline of magic that has been studied and venerated for centuries, one whose practitioners are so varied that there can be no determining where the concept originated. It can be said, however, that most modern refinements in the design of such items…

items.Name: Wand of Illusion
items.Description: Those who create items of this type are not quick to let their names be known, as they are often accused of cruelty or treacherous behavior. As useful as Wands of Paralyzation are, they are forever linked to tales of strong warriors rendered helpless and forced to endure gods kn…

items.Name: War Monk's Suit
items.Description: The Shining Hand Monastery in Vaasa has made an impressive reputation, and a small fortune, designing these robes. Demand has spread across many nations, such that different variations on the similar robes keep the monks hard at work. The robes increase a monk’s senses to such a…

items.Name: Dart of Stunning Poison
items.Description: Darts of this type can stun their targets, though potency and duration are determined by the power of the dart's creator.

items.Name: X's Robe
items.Description: X the Mystic's robe seems tailor made for him. Or is it her?
PropertiesDecoded: Lawful Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Yuan-Ti Temple Key
items.Description: This strange key seems to open a door. But to where..?
